mapper.sql: select p.profile_id, p.visitor_uid, p.latest_questionnaire_id, p.latest_questionnaire_id as questionnaire_id, p.profile_json, p.light_tag_code, p.water_tag_code, p.space_tag_code, p.style_tag_code, p.budget_level, p.pet_preference, p.care_preference, p.last_recommend_time, p.create_time, p.update_time, q.answer_json, q.environment_summary, q.preference_summary, q.budget_value, q.submit_time from zx_user_profile p left join zx_questionnaire_record q on p.latest_questionnaire_id = q.questionnaire_id
mapper.insert: insert into zx_user_profile (visitor_uid, latest_questionnaire_id, profile_json, light_tag_code, water_tag_code, space_tag_code, style_tag_code, budget_level, pet_preference, care_preference, last_recommend_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{visitorUid}, #{latestQuestionnaireId}, #{profileJson}, #{lightTagCode}, #{waterTagCode}, #{spaceTagCode}, #{styleTagCode}, #{budgetLevel}, #{petPreference}, #{carePreference}, #{lastRecommendTime}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update zx_user_profile set latest_questionnaire_id = #{latestQuestionnaireId}, profile_json = #{profileJson}, light_tag_code = #{lightTagCode}, water_tag_code = #{waterTagCode}, space_tag_code = #{spaceTagCode}, style_tag_code = #{styleTagCode}, budget_level = #{budgetLevel}, pet_preference = #{petPreference}, care_preference = #{carePreference}, last_recommend_time = #{lastRecommendTime}, update_time = sysdate() where profile_id = #{profileId}
